message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" They want earliest reference from historical record. We can answer: earliest references are in the New Testament (Gospels), but also in non-Christian sources like Josephus, Tacitus, Pliny the Younger, etc. The earliest non-Christian mention is in the Jewish historian Flavius Josephus, in his Antiquities of the Jews, written around 93-94 CE, referencing Jesus. Also Tacitus wrote about Christ in Annals around 116 CE. The earliest mention is in the Gospel of Mark, written around 70 CE.
